review:
Reign of Rome builds on the LootLines idea from Donny Dough: Tribute symbols forming a winning payline create a LootLine, and their values are combined left to right before being multiplied by your bet. Adding tributes contribute 1x to 10x, revealing ones 15x to 500x, and multiplying tributes double to quintuple the running total.

Because multiplying tributes act on whatever has built up before them, position along the line really matters. A line of small adders followed by an x5 can turn into something decent. With a 15,000x maximum and four tribute types to track, it takes a few spins to learn, but the Roman setting keeps it readable.
